statements.quote: The strong demand for transceivers in hyperscale datacenters and AI superclusters continues unabated.
statements.notes: This links transceiver sales to datacenter and AI demand in words only. The sentence that follows says 200G/400G/800G transceivers are 'about a third of our datacom transceiver business'. That is a share of one product line, not of total revenue, and the sentence does not call it AI or data-center revenue, so it was not recorded as explicit_share. The sentence names no year, so code uses the reported fiscal year (2022).
